mythology: Sati's left cheek fell here; Devi manifested as Twarita (Bhavani) to protect sage Kardama's wife Anubhuti from the demon Kukur and blessed Shivaji Maharaj with the divine sword.
pilgrimage_significance: Family deity (Kuladaivat) of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and millions of households across Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Telangana; celebrated as the quick-responding mother (Twarita).
historical_notes: Immortalized in Bhavani Ashtakam and Maratha chronicles as the spiritual fountainhead of Hindu self-rule (Hindavi Swarajya).
